message:
Summary: USER_CONTEXT: Investigate and reproduce a crash in lwan's HTTP request parsing (fuzz target `fuzz_parse_http_request`). The fuzzer sets `REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS`. Need to build a standalone test to verify the crash with a PoC file.

COMPLETED:
- Examined `parse_proxy_protocol_v1()` (lines 160-225) and `parse_proxy_protocol()` (lines 1179-1190) in lwan-request.c
- Found existing build at `/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/` with ASan enabled (`-fsanitize=address`)
- Located precompiled object: `/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/lwan/src/lib/CMakeFiles/lwan-static.dir/lwan-request.c.o`
- Created standalone test harness (`standalone_test.c`) with `LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput` wrapper
- Attempted compilation but failed due to missing dependencies (coro, lwan_array, sha1, base64, etc.)

PENDING:
- Successfully compile a standalone fuzzer test binary
- Run the test with the PoC file to reproduce the crash
- Analyze the crash and determine root cause

CURRENT_STATE:
- Source: `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c`
- Build dir: `/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/`
- Build config: ASan enabled, `-DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION`
- Test harness: `/workspace/standalone_test.c` (calls `fuzz_parse_http_request`)
- Precompiled object: `/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/lwan/src/lib/CMakeFiles/lwan-static.dir/lwan-request.c.o`
- Library: `/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/lwan/src/lib/liblwan.a` (but missing `__start_lwan_module`/`__stop_lwan_module` symbols)

CODE_STATE:
- File: `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c`
- Key functions examined: `parse_proxy_protocol_v1()`, `parse_proxy_protocol()`, `has_crlfcrlf()`
- Fuzz target: `fuzz_parse_http_request()` (declared in lwan-request.c)

TESTS:
- Compilation errors: undefined references to `coro_*`, `lwan_array_*`, `sha1_*`, `base64_*`, `lwan_*`, `timeouts_*`, `streq`, `umask_for_tmpfile`, `parse_long`, `lwan_char_isspace`, `lwan_parse_rfc_time`, `lwan_status_*`
- Linker errors: `__start_lwan_module`/`__stop_lwan_module` (linker-provided symbols from section attributes)

DEPS:
- Missing: coro library, lwan internal libraries (sha1, base64, timeouts, trie, array, etc.), zlib (`-lz`), pthread (`-lpthread`)
- Build system uses clang with libc++ (not gcc)

VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS:
- Repository: `/workspace/repo-vul/` (contains src-vul and work-vul directories)
- No git branch/commit info available
